description: This Java class handles commands to waive charges on savings accounts within the Fineract platform. It acts as a command handler that invokes the savings account write service to perform the waiver action based on incoming command data.

classes.name: WaiveSavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing 'waive' commands on savings account charges.

methods.name: WaiveSavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the waive charge command by invoking the write platform service.
